text: その　へんの　やつ　から　また　むりやり　とって　きたぜ！

structure.jp: その　へんの　やつ　から

structure.en: I took it and came back!

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる after a て-form verb here means doing something somewhere and then coming back. とって　きた = 'I took it and came here'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is a rough, boyish way of telling someone something. とって　きたぜ = 'I went and took it, man'.
